verdict.rationale: Discord's first-party pages describe a space to 'talk, play, and hang out' and list 'HD video streaming' as a Nitro perk. That implies native in-app voice and video, but nothing documents starting an audio or video call from a channel or DM. Social SDK voice chat is a developer building block for games and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of one-click voice/video calls from DMs and channels, admin-relevant call controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
